newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOST HUNGARY MARKETS CLOSED DESPITE WORKING DAY.
newsitem.headline: MOST HUNGARY MARKETS CLOSED DESPITE WORKING DAY.

text.p: Most of Hungary's financial markets remained closed on Saturday, although it is a working day, to replace next Friday which will be part of four days of holidays.
The interbank forint market was open Saturday morning. The overnight interest rates closed at 20.5 percent, down from Friday's closing of 21 percent.

The interbank foreign exchange market, which opens at 0700 GMT, is not likely to work at all on Saturday as foreign markets are closed and the National Bank of Hungary does not quote foreign currencies today, dealers said at about 0745 GMT.
The markets of the Budapest Stock Exchange and the Budapest Commodity Exchange are closed on Saturday, the bourses said.
